content: My lower back hurts after deadlifts, should I keep going?

Lower back pain after deadlifts is worth taking seriously, Alex. Don't push through it. Cut the load, or pause deadlifts for now, and only train in ranges that stay pain-free. ⚠️

Check your form too. Keep your lats tight, keep the bar close to your body, and don't round your back. If the pain is sharp, lasts more than a few days, or comes with numbness or pain running down your leg, stop and see a doctor or physio. I can't diagnose it from here.

Want me to swap deadlifts for a lighter hip hinge, like a Romanian deadlift or a back extension, in a workout? Just say whether you mean today only or for good.
